data.verdict: 5₂ REFUTES the single-scalar-symmetry-constant reading [scope-(a), structural]. Unlike amphichiral 4₁ — where S⁺≅S⁻ under ι and one scalar (S12+S21)/S11 = 3 serves both — chiral 5₂ splits the DT spectrum [Fraction(3, 1), Fraction(4, 1)] across the two Stokes matrices (S⁺ carries 4, S⁻ carries 3). The bar-odd observable ω = βp − β⁻¹q is ι-ODD (BarOddAntisymOffDiagonal.omega_iota_odd) and vanishes on the amphichiral (ι-fixed) locus, so it cannot be carried by the ι-EVEN symmetric-sum constant that gives the scalar 3. The 5₂ data are therefore consistent with a SPECTRUM-reflecting / chirality-split reading, NOT the universal scalar A_ω=3. This neither confirms A=2 (κ_shape) nor A=3 (A_ω·κ_pot) as a universal scalar: the correct object is per-chirality (the {3,4} split), which at 4₁ degenerates to the single 3 because the two chiralities coincide. Whether the OBSERVABLE inherits the sum (3+4)/… , the S⁺ member (4), or the S⁻ member (3) is the residual normalization fork (qou-yh67); 5₂ shows it is a CHOICE AMONG SPECTRUM MEMBERS, not a knot-independent constant.
